title: Fusion Lanes: Quarterly roadmap for hosted API + model curation
creator: Priya Patel
description: This ticket defines a distinct quarterly planning approach were calling 'Fusion Lanes' to synchronize hosted API release windows, model cohort curation, and measurable OKRs. The goal is to reduce cross-team coordination overhead during model swaps and to create a predictable two-week cadence for canaries, experiments, and tiered rotations. Fusion Lanes groups models into three cohorts by stability and cost-sensitivity, then aligns hosted API release lanes, rollback guardrails, and evaluation gate sets across PM, Eng, Design, and CS teams. This plan emphasizes faster decision loops for pruning, A/B canaries, and emergency fallback policies while preserving throughput and latency SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Three model cohorts defined with acceptance criteria, metrics, and owner assignments
Quarterly calendar with two-week canary windows and contingency buffers published
Canary gating checklist and automated smoke evals integrated with CI for hosted endpoints
Runbook for rollback + fallback to compatible model variants documented and reviewed
OKR mapping showing targets for latency P95, unit token cost reduction, and model quality regressions
tasks: Draft cohort definitions (stability, cost-sensitivity, customer exposure) - PM lead
Inventory hosted endpoints and map model variants to lanes - Eng ops
Define automated eval prompt sets and thresholds - Research
Design canary dashboard widgets and UX for rollouts - Design
Schedule cross-team kickoff and stakeholder sign-off - PM
Publish quarter calendar and update Console release page - PM + Eng
